scope_guards: National Highways planning engagement and consultation are not the local planning authority's decision.
Strategic-road policy does not grant a new or altered access to the network.
RIS3 funding and programme maps are not site-specific junction commitments or completion dates.
Network-wide performance is not local link, junction or development capacity.
A nearby strategic-road scheme does not prove benefit, mitigation delivery or legal access for a candidate.
Planning permission, highway agreement, land rights and technical approval remain distinct.
Traffic modelling, safety assessment and mitigation must match the exact proposal and network location.
No score or promotion is written without exact access, modelling, consultation, agreement, land and planning evidence.
